subject: DS474
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. Arabic coverage was limited for 'Collaborative Systems' due to irrelevant search results (confusing it with cooperative societies) and for 'Crowdsourcing' due to a lack of eligible candidates passing the hard gates.

coverage.note: Selected candidate has <3k views but is the only relevant video, qualifying under the view count exception rule.
All candidates were about 'cooperative societies' (الجمعيات التعاونية), not collaborative software systems, failing the relevance gate.
The only Arabic candidate failed the duration gate (>3600s); all other shortlisted videos were in English.

videos.title: How can groups make good decisions? | Mariano Sigman and Dan Ariely
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed TED talk provides an engaging and conceptually strong introduction to the dynamics and challenges of group decision making.

videos.title: DSS vs GDSS | Decision support system | Group decision support system | MIS | BBA/MBA | ppt
videos.filter_reason: This video's 'DSS vs GDSS' comparison is a pedagogically excellent way to define GDSS, and it has a strong view count.

videos.title: Real-Time Collaboration Explained - System Design
videos.filter_reason: This is a perfect technical explanation of the system design behind real-time collaboration, ideal for a university-level audience.

videos.title: What is Collective Intelligence?
videos.filter_reason: This video excels at defining and differentiating the core concepts of the topic, providing the conceptual clarity needed for academic study.

videos.title: Humans vs. AI: Who should make the decision?
videos.filter_reason: From IBM, this highly popular video uses an engaging 'Humans vs. AI' framing to explore the collaborative potential in decision-making.

videos.title: الفصل الرابع   اتخاذ القرارات الجماعية
videos.filter_reason: This is a direct, full-length academic lecture on the topic and the only relevant candidate available, qualifying via the view count exception.

videos.title: Chapter 3. Decision Support Systems (DSS).
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive academic lecture that passes all gates and explicitly covers Group Decision Support Systems within its curriculum.

videos.title: الانسان والذكاء الاصطناعي صراع أم شراكة؟Humans and Artificial Intelligence Conflict or Partnership?
videos.filter_reason: With a massive view count and an excellent 'Conflict or Partnership?' framing, this in-depth discussion is a perfect fit for the topic.
